# ScreenVault — Landing Page Build Instructions

## Overview

Build a single-page landing site for **ScreenVault**, a massive UI/UX design inspiration library (400,000+ screenshots). The audience is product designers and design teams who need fast reference material. The page must convert visitors into free or paid users by demonstrating the library's depth, powerful search, and workflow integrations.

## Tone & Visual Direction

Think **clean, contemporary SaaS** — generous whitespace, crisp typography, and a neutral palette (white/off-white backgrounds, near-black text, subtle grays). Use a single vibrant accent color (electric blue or violet) for CTAs and interactive highlights. Typography should feel premium: a geometric or grotesque sans-serif (Inter, General Sans, or similar). Rounded corners on cards and pills; soft shadows. The overall mood is *"polished design tool"* — the site itself should feel like something a designer would respect.

## Key Priorities

1. **Interactions are the core experience.** The animated stat counters, search tab switching, filter pills, and flows toggle must feel responsive and polished — these demonstrate the product's power. Use smooth transitions (200–300ms easing) and make sure tab/filter state changes are visually obvious.

2. **Testimonials & brand marquees** should create a sense of momentum — continuous, buttery-smooth horizontal scrolling that reinforces social proof without requiring user effort.

3. **Stats section** needs to land with impact. The counting animation should trigger on scroll-into-view and feel satisfying (ease-out, staggered start).

4. **Responsive design is non-negotiable.** The screenshot grids, filter pill rows, and multi-row testimonial carousels must gracefully adapt from desktop to mobile.

5. **Hero clarity** — the headline, one-liner, and dual CTAs ("Join for free" + "See our plans") must be immediately scannable above the fold.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section order, interaction specs, data values, and navigation definitions.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

3	## Brand
4	ScreenVault is a comprehensive design inspiration library for UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams. It offers a fully searchable collection of mobile and web app screenshots, user flows, and UI elements to accelerate design research and decision-making. The tone is modern, minimal, and professional.
5	
6	Brand colors: #141414 (primary dark), #FFFFFF (background white), #F5F5F5 (light gray surface)
7	
8	## Announcement Bar
9	2025 ScreenVault Awards — Celebrating the best on the internet.
10	
11	## Hero Content
12	Title: Discover real-world design inspiration.
13	Subtitle: Featuring over 1,000 iOS & Web apps, and 200 sites — New content weekly.
14	Primary CTA: "Join for free"
15	Secondary CTA: "See our plans"
16	
17	Navigation links: Pricing · Awards · Log in
18	
19	## Social Proof
20	Trusted by design teams at: (display as logo row of well-known tech/design companies)
21	
22	## Library Statistics
23	A growing library of:
24	- **1,150** apps
25	- **615,900** screens
26	- **329,200** flows
27	
28	These numbers animate with a counting effect when the section scrolls into view.
29	
30	## Search Categories
31	Filter pill categories available for browsing design patterns:
32	- Profile
33	- Wallet
34	- Welcome
35	- Account Setup
36	- Home
37	- Subscription & Paywall
38	- Login
39	- Settings
40	- Checkout
41	- Collections
42	
43	Pills are displayed in a horizontally scrollable row and update the screenshot grid when selected.
44	
45	## Feature Tabs
46	Tab navigation options within the search feature section:
47	- **Screens** — Browse full-screen captures of real apps
48	- **UI Elements** — Explore individual components and patterns
49	- **Flows** — View connected sequences of screens
50	- **Text in Screenshot** — Search by visible on-screen copy
51	
52	Clicking a tab switches the content area to show the corresponding search results view.
53	
54	## Feature: Search
55	**Find design patterns in seconds.**
56	The search feature section combines the tab navigation (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) with filter pills to let users quickly narrow down relevant design references from the library. The grid of screenshot results updates dynamically based on the active tab and selected filter category.
57	
58	## Feature: Flows
59	**Explore entire user journeys with flows.**
60	
61	- **Videos** — Experience flows the way they were meant to be experienced, complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.

72	
73	Each tool is presented as a feature card with a visual preview and short description.

# ScreenVault — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps

## Brand
ScreenVault is a comprehensive design inspiration library for UI/UX designers, product designers, and design teams. It offers a fully searchable collection of mobile and web app screenshots, user flows, and UI elements to accelerate design research and decision-making. The tone is modern, minimal, and professional.

Brand colors: #141414 (primary dark), #FFFFFF (background white), #F5F5F5 (light gray surface)

## Announcement Bar
2025 ScreenVault Awards — Celebrating the best on the internet.

## Hero Content
Title: Discover real-world design inspiration.
Subtitle: Featuring over 1,000 iOS & Web apps, and 200 sites — New content weekly.
Primary CTA: "Join for free"
Secondary CTA: "See our plans"

Navigation links: Pricing · Awards · Log in

## Social Proof
Trusted by design teams at: (display as logo row of well-known tech/design companies)

## Library Statistics
A growing library of:
- **1,150** apps
- **615,900** screens
- **329,200** flows

These numbers animate with a counting effect when the section scrolls into view.

## Search Categories
Filter pill categories available for browsing design patterns:
- Profile
- Wallet
- Welcome
- Account Setup
- Home
- Subscription & Paywall
- Login
- Settings
- Checkout
- Collections

Pills are displayed in a horizontally scrollable row and update the screenshot grid when selected.

## Feature Tabs
Tab navigation options within the search feature section:
- **Screens** — Browse full-screen captures of real apps
- **UI Elements** — Explore individual components and patterns
- **Flows** — View connected sequences of screens
- **Text in Screenshot** — Search by visible on-screen copy

Clicking a tab switches the content area to show the corresponding search results view.

## Feature: Search
**Find design patterns in seconds.**
The search feature section combines the tab navigation (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) with filter pills to let users quickly narrow down relevant design references from the library. The grid of screenshot results updates dynamically based on the active tab and selected filter category.

## Feature: Flows
**Explore entire user journeys with flows.**

- **Videos** — Experience flows the way they were meant to be experienced, complete with transitions, micro-interactions, and animations.
- **Prototype mode** — Walk through flows, step by step, by using the interactive hotspots at your own preferred pace.

A toggle switches between the Videos view and the Prototype mode view.

## Inspiration Tools
**From inspiration to creation.**

- **Copy to Figma** — Download designs you like or copy them straight into Figma with our new Figma plugin.
- **Save to collections** — Collect your favorite designs and upload your own screenshots into one place.
- **Leave comments** — Take notes upon saving so you'll never forget the context in the future.

Each tool is presented as a feature card with a visual preview and short description.

## Testimonials
**What our users are saying.**

Displayed as a multi-row, auto-scrolling marquee carousel of testimonial cards.

- **Sebastian Speier**, Shop — "ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape."
- **Meng To**, DesignCode — "ScreenVault is a game-changer for designers looking to step up their understanding of UX and UI design patterns. It's so massive, meticulously organized, has deep user flows and even a Figma plugin! It's indispensable in the modern designer's toolbox."
- **Marco Cornacchia**, Figma — "ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows."
- **Daryl Ginn**, Endless — "ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space."
- **Rachel How** — "ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!"
- **Haerin Song**, Visa — "By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!"

## CTA Section
**Never run out of inspiration again.**
Use ScreenVault for free as long as you like or get full access with any of our paid plans.

Primary CTA: "Join for free"
Secondary CTA: "See our plans"

Below the CTA, rows of recognizable app icons scroll in a continuous horizontal marquee animation in alternating directions. Brands include: Coinbase, Wise, Headspace, Airbnb, Uber, Nike, Pinterest, ChatGPT, Shopify, Loom, Mailchimp, Twitch, Spotify, Apple TV, Notion, Dropbox.

**Tagline:** Design better digital experiences with ScreenVault.

Contact: Help center · Careers · Merch · Support
Social: X (Twitter) · LinkedIn

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>ScreenVault — UI & UX Design Inspiration for Mobile & Web Apps</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Save hours of UI & UX research with a library of 400,000+ fully searchable mobile & web app screenshots.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --primary-dark: #141414;
      --bg-white: #FFFFFF;
      --surface-gray: #F5F5F5;
      --text-secondary: #6B7280;
      --text-tertiary: #9CA3AF;
      --border-color: #E5E7EB;
      --accent: #6C5CE7;
      --accent-hover: #5A4BD1;
      --accent-light: #EDE9FF;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-pill: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --transition: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      background: var(--bg-white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== ANNOUNCEMENT BAR ===== */
    .announcement-bar {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .announcement-bar a {
      color: #A78BFA;
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 6px;
    }
    .announcement-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== HEADER / NAV ===== */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .logo-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--primary-dark); }
    .nav-links .btn-login {
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 80px 24px 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px;
      height: 800px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(108,92,231,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero .subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(108,92,231,0.3);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary-dark);
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }

    /* ===== TRUSTED BY / LOGO MARQUEE ===== */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: 48px 0 56px;
      text-align: center;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .trusted-by-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .logo-marquee-wrapper {
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
    }
    .logo-marquee {
      display: flex;
      gap: 56px;
      animation: marquee-scroll 30s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .logo-marquee .brand-item {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .logo-marquee .brand-item:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

    @keyframes marquee-scroll {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats-section {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }
    .stats-label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .stat-card {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 32px 16px;
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES: SEARCH ===== */
    .features-search {
      padding: 96px 0;
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-header p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Tabs */
    .search-tabs {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      padding: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      overflow-x: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }
    .search-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .search-tab {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .search-tab.active {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .search-tab:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--primary-dark); }

    /* Filter Pills */
    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }
    .filter-pill {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-white);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .filter-pill.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .filter-pill:hover:not(.active) {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* Screenshot Grid */
    .screenshot-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .screenshot-card .placeholder-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 16px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .status-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-header {
      height: 14px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      width: 60%;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-content {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(1) { width: 90%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(2) { width: 75%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(3) { width: 85%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(4) { width: 65%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-block {
      height: 60px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      margin: 8px 0;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-circle {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-btn {
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--accent);
      opacity: 0.2;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-top: auto;
    }
    .screenshot-card .app-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.7));
      color: white;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; }

    /* ===== FEATURES: FLOWS ===== */
    .features-flows {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }
    .flows-toggle {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      padding: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 360px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .flows-toggle-btn {
      padding: 10px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
      flex: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .flows-toggle-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .flows-content {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 40px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .flow-view { display: none; }
    .flow-view.active { display: block; }
    .flow-steps {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .flow-step {
      min-width: 160px;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .flow-step::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-right: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
      transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-45deg);
    }
    .flow-step:last-child::after { display: none; }
    .flow-video-placeholder {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .play-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(108,92,231,0.3);
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .play-icon:hover { transform: scale(1.08); }
    .play-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      fill: white;
      margin-left: 3px;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES: TOOLS ===== */
    .features-tools {
      padding: 96px 0;
    }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .tool-card {
      padding: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      background: var(--bg-white);
    }
    .tool-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .tool-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--accent-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .tool-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .tool-card h3 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .tool-card p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials-section {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row:nth-child(1) .testimonial-track {
      animation: testimonial-scroll-left 40s linear infinite;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row:nth-child(2) .testimonial-track {
      animation: testimonial-scroll-right 45s linear infinite;
    }
    .testimonial-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      min-width: 380px;
      max-width: 420px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
    }
    .testimonial-company {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    @keyframes testimonial-scroll-left {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes testimonial-scroll-right {
      from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      to { transform: translateX(0); }
    }

    /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 96px 0 0;
      text-align: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-section h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-section .cta-desc {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
    }
    .cta-buttons {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }

    /* App Icon Marquee */
    .app-icon-marquee-wrapper {
      padding: 32px 0;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent);
    }
    .app-icon-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .app-icon-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .app-icon-row:nth-child(odd) .app-icon-track {
      animation: marquee-scroll 35s linear infinite;
    }
    .app-icon-row:nth-child(even) .app-icon-track {
      animation: marquee-scroll-reverse 38s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes marquee-scroll-reverse {
      from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      to { transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    .app-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      color: white;
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .footer-brand {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #9CA3AF;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: #9CA3AF;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .footer-col a {
      color: #D1D5DB;

    // ===== STATS COUNTER ANIMATION =====
    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10);
      const duration = 2000;
      const startTime = performance.now();

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const counters = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
          counters.forEach((counter, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => animateCounter(counter), i * 200);

          statsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

    // ===== DATA =====

      { name: "Rachel How", company: "", text: "ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!" },

I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!" },
    ];

    const appBrands = [
      { name: "Coinbase", color: "#0052FF" },
      { name: "Wise", color: "#9FE870" },
      { name: "Headspace", color: "#F47D31" },
      { name: "Airbnb", color: "#FF5A5F" },
      { name: "Uber", color: "#000000" },
      { name: "Nike", color: "#111111" },
      { name: "Pinterest", color: "#E60023" },
      { name: "ChatGPT", color: "#10A37F" },
      { name: "Shopify", color: "#96BF48" },
      { name: "Loom", color: "#625DF5" },
      { name: "Mailchimp", color: "#FFE01B" },
      { name: "Twitch", color: "#9146FF" },
      { name: "Spotify", color: "#1DB954" },
      { name: "Apple TV", color: "#333333" },
      { name: "Notion", color: "#000000" },
      { name: "Dropbox", color: "#0061FF" },
    ];

    const screenshotApps = [
      "Instagram", "Spotify", "Airbnb", "Uber", "Duolingo", "Nike", "Slack", "Notion",
      "Figma", "Linear", "Stripe", "Discord", "WhatsApp", "Telegram", "Pinterest", "TikTok"
    ];

    const filterCategories = ["profile","wallet","welcome","account-setup","home","subscription","login","settings","checkout","collections"];

    // ===== SCREENSHOT GRID GENERATION =====
    function generateScreenCards(containerId, count, seed) {
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const idx = (seed + i) % screenshotApps.length;
        const app = screenshotApps[idx];
        const hue = (idx * 37) % 360;
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'screenshot-card';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="placeholder-screen" style="background:hsl(${hue},12%,96%);">
            <div class="status-bar"><span>9:41</span><span>●●●</span></div>
            <div class="screen-header" style="background:hsl(${hue},15%,88%);"></div>
            <div class="screen-content">
              <div class="screen-line" style="background:hsl(${hue},10%,90%);"></div>
              <div class="screen-line" style="background:hsl(${hue},10%,91%);"></div>
              <div class="screen-block" style="background:hsl(${hue},12%,88%);"></div>
              <div class="screen-line" style="background:hsl(${hue},10%,90%);"></div>
              <div class="screen-line" style="background:hsl(${hue},10%,92%);"></div>
              <div class="screen-btn"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="app-label">${app}</div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
      }
    }

    // Initial grid
    generateScreenCards('screenshotGrid', 8, 0);
    generateScreenCards('elementsGrid', 8, 4);
    generateScreenCards('flowsGrid', 8, 8);
    generateScreenCards('textGrid', 8, 12);

    // ===== PROTOTYPE FLOW STEPS =====
    (function() {
      const container = document.getElementById('prototypeSteps');
      const steps = ['Splash', 'Onboarding', 'Sign Up', 'Home', 'Profile', 'Settings'];

        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'flow-step';
        const hue = (i * 50 + 200) % 360;
        el.style.background = `hsl(${hue},12%,96%)`;
        el.innerHTML = `<span style="position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);">${step}</span>`;
        container.appendChild(el);
      });
    })();

    // ===== SEARCH TABS =====
    document.querySelectorAll('.search-tab').forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.search-tab').forEach(t => { t.classList.remove('active'); t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); });
        tab.classList.add('active');
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
        const target = tab.dataset.tab;
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tc => tc.classList.remove('active'));
        const mapping = { screens: 'tab-screens', elements: 'tab-elements', flows: 'tab-flows', text: 'tab-text' };
        document.getElementById(mapping[target]).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // ===== FILTER PILLS =====
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill').forEach(pill => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        pill.classList.add('active');
        const filterIdx = filterCategories.indexOf(pill.dataset.filter);
        const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-content.active');
        const gridId = activeTab.querySelector('.screenshot-grid').id;
        generateScreenCards(gridId, 8, filterIdx * 3);
      });
    });

    // ===== FLOWS TOGGLE =====
    document.querySelectorAll('.flows-toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.flows-toggle-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.querySelectorAll('.flow-view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById('flow-' + btn.dataset.flow).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // ===== STATS COUNTER ANIMATION =====
    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10);
      const duration = 2000;
      const startTime = performance.now();

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const counters = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
          counters.forEach((counter, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => animateCounter(counter), i * 200);
          });
          statsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    statsObserver.observe(document.getElementById('statsSection'));

    // ===== TESTIMONIAL MARQUEE =====
    function buildTestimonialCard(t) {
      const initials = t.name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('');
      return `
        <div class="testimonial-card">
          <p class="testimonial-text">“${t.text}”</p>
          <div class="testimonial-author">
            <div class="testimonial-avatar">${initials}</div>
            <div>
              <div class="testimonial-name">${t.name}</div>
              ${t.company ? `<div class="testimonial-company">${t.company}</div>` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    (function() {
      const row1 = document.getElementById('testimonialRow1');
      const row2 = document.getElementById('testimonialRow2');
      const set1 = [testimonials[0], testimonials[1], testimonials[2]];
      const set2 = [testimonials[3], testimonials[4], testimonials[5]];

      const html1 = set1.map(buildTestimonialCard).join('');
      const html2 = set2.map(buildTestimonialCard).join('');

      row1.innerHTML = html1 + html1 + html1 + html1;
      row2.innerHTML = html2 + html2 + html2 + html2;
    })();

    // ===== APP ICON MARQUEE =====
    (function() {
      const row1 = document.getElementById('appIconRow1');
      const row2 = document.getElementById('appIconRow2');
      const set1 = appBrands.slice(0, 8);
      const set2 = appBrands.slice(8);

      function iconHTML(brands) {
        return brands.map(b => {
          const textColor = ['#FFE01B','#9FE870'].includes(b.color) ? '#333' : '#fff';
          return `<div class="app-icon" style="background:${b.color};color:${textColor};">${b.name.substring(0,2)}</div>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      const track1HTML = iconHTML(set1);
      const track2HTML = iconHTML(set2);

      row1.innerHTML = `<div class="app-icon-track">${track1HTML}${track1HTML}</div>`;
      row2.innerHTML = `<div class="app-icon-track">${track2HTML}${track2HTML}</div>`;
    })();
  </script>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --primary-dark: #141414;
      --bg-white: #FFFFFF;
      --surface-gray: #F5F5F5;
      --text-secondary: #6B7280;
      --text-tertiary: #9CA3AF;
      --border-color: #E5E7EB;
      --accent: #6C5CE7;
      --accent-hover: #5A4BD1;
      --accent-light: #EDE9FF;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-pill: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      --transition: 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      background: var(--bg-white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* ===== ANNOUNCEMENT BAR ===== */
    .announcement-bar {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      color: white;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .announcement-bar a {
      color: #A78BFA;
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-left: 6px;
    }
    .announcement-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ===== HEADER / NAV ===== */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .logo-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--primary-dark); }
    .nav-links .btn-login {
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 80px 24px 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -200px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 800px;
      height: 800px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(108,92,231,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero .subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(108,92,231,0.3);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary-dark);
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }

    /* ===== TRUSTED BY / LOGO MARQUEE ===== */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: 48px 0 56px;
      text-align: center;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .trusted-by-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .logo-marquee-wrapper {
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
    }
    .logo-marquee {
      display: flex;
      gap: 56px;
      animation: marquee-scroll 30s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .logo-marquee .brand-item {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .logo-marquee .brand-item:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

    @keyframes marquee-scroll {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ===== STATS ===== */
    .stats-section {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }
    .stats-label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .stat-card {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 32px 16px;
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES: SEARCH ===== */
    .features-search {
      padding: 96px 0;
    }
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-header p {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Tabs */
    .search-tabs {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      padding: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      overflow-x: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    }
    .search-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .search-tab {
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .search-tab.active {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .search-tab:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--primary-dark); }

    /* Filter Pills */
    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }
    .filter-pill {
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-color);
      background: var(--bg-white);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .filter-pill.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .filter-pill:hover:not(.active) {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* Screenshot Grid */
    .screenshot-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      position: relative;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .screenshot-card .placeholder-screen {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 16px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .status-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-header {
      height: 14px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      width: 60%;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-content {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(1) { width: 90%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(2) { width: 75%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(3) { width: 85%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-line:nth-child(4) { width: 65%; }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-block {
      height: 60px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      margin: 8px 0;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-circle {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .placeholder-screen .screen-btn {
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--accent);
      opacity: 0.2;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-top: auto;
    }
    .screenshot-card .app-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.7));
      color: white;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .tab-content { display: none; }
    .tab-content.active { display: block; }

    /* ===== FEATURES: FLOWS ===== */
    .features-flows {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
    }
    .flows-toggle {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      padding: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      max-width: 360px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .flows-toggle-btn {
      padding: 10px 24px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: inherit;
      flex: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .flows-toggle-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: white;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .flows-content {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 40px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .flow-view { display: none; }
    .flow-view.active { display: block; }
    .flow-steps {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .flow-step {
      min-width: 160px;
      aspect-ratio: 9/16;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .flow-step::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: -12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-right: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
      transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-45deg);
    }
    .flow-step:last-child::after { display: none; }
    .flow-video-placeholder {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .play-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(108,92,231,0.3);
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }
    .play-icon:hover { transform: scale(1.08); }
    .play-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      fill: white;
      margin-left: 3px;
    }

    /* ===== FEATURES: TOOLS ===== */
    .features-tools {
      padding: 96px 0;
    }
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }
    .tool-card {
      padding: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      background: var(--bg-white);
    }
    .tool-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .tool-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background: var(--accent-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .tool-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .tool-card h3 {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .tool-card p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials-section {
      padding: 96px 0;
      background: var(--surface-gray);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row:nth-child(1) .testimonial-track {
      animation: testimonial-scroll-left 40s linear infinite;
    }
    .testimonial-marquee-row:nth-child(2) .testimonial-track {
      animation: testimonial-scroll-right 45s linear infinite;
    }
    .testimonial-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg-white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      min-width: 380px;
      max-width: 420px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .testimonial-text {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .testimonial-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
    }
    .testimonial-company {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
    }

    @keyframes testimonial-scroll-left {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    @keyframes testimonial-scroll-right {
      from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      to { transform: translateX(0); }
    }

    /* ===== CTA SECTION ===== */
    .cta-section {
      padding: 96px 0 0;
      text-align: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cta-section h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cta-section .cta-desc {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
    }
    .cta-buttons {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }

    /* App Icon Marquee */
    .app-icon-marquee-wrapper {
      padding: 32px 0;
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent);
    }
    .app-icon-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      width: max-content;
    }
    .app-icon-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .app-icon-row:nth-child(odd) .app-icon-track {
      animation: marquee-scroll 35s linear infinite;
    }
    .app-icon-row:nth-child(even) .app-icon-track {
      animation: marquee-scroll-reverse 38s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes marquee-scroll-reverse {
      from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      to { transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    .app-icon {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--primary-dark);
      color: white;
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }
    .footer-brand {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #9CA3AF;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 280px;
    }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: #9CA3AF;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .footer-col a {
      color: #D1D5DB;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }
    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid #374151;
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #6B7280;
    }
    .footer-bottom a {
      color: #6B7280;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }
    .footer-bottom a:hover { color: #D1D5DB; }
    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .screenshot-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
    }

    const appBrands = [
      { name: "Coinbase", color: "#0052FF" },

      { name: "Headspace", color: "#F47D31" },

    const filterCategories = ["profile","wallet","welcome","account-setup","home","subscription","login","settings","checkout","collections"];

    function generateScreenCards(containerId, count, seed) {
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const idx = (seed + i) % screenshotApps.length;
        const app = screenshotApps[idx];

        document.querySelectorAll('.flow-view').forEach(v => v.classList.remove('active'));
        document.getElementById('flow-' + btn.dataset.flow).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // ===== STATS COUNTER ANIMATION =====
    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10);
      const duration = 2000;
      const startTime = performance.now();

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const counters = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
          counters.forEach((counter, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => animateCounter(counter), i * 200);
          });
          statsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    statsObserver.observe(document.getElementById('statsSection'));

    // ===== TESTIMONIAL MARQUEE =====
    function buildTestimonialCard(t) {

      const html1 = set1.map(buildTestimonialCard).join('');
      const html2 = set2.map(buildTestimonialCard).join('');

      row1.innerHTML = html1 + html1 + html1 + html1;
      row2.innerHTML = html2 + html2 + html2 + html2;
    })();

    // ===== APP ICON MARQUEE =====
    (function() {
      const row1 = document.getElementById('appIconRow1');
      const row2 = document.getElementById('appIconRow2');
      const set1 = appBrands.slice(0, 8);
      const set2 = appBrands.slice(8);

          return `<div class="app-icon" style="background:${b.color};color:${textColor};">${b.name.substring(0,2)}</div>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      const track1HTML = iconHTML(set1);
      const track2HTML = iconHTML(set2);

      row1.innerHTML = `<div class="app-icon-track">${track1HTML}${track1HTML}</div>`;
      row2.innerHTML = `<div class="app-icon-track">${track2HTML}${track2HTML}</div>`;
    })();
  </script>
